blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models often produce semantically similar answers to open-ended questions, even when many plausible alternatives exist. Generating useful alternatives requires identifying both what the query calls for and what existing responses already cover. We introduce Gap Detection, a framework that searches for relevant but unoccupied directions in a shared text embedding space. Its objective, GapScore, combines query relevance (Demand) with dissimilarity to the nearest existing item (Defensibility). The framework optimizes this product on the unit sphere, maps candidate directions to concept words with a language model, and uses task-specific filtering and constrained prompting to turn those concepts into text. On five curated topics and 90 INFINITY-CHAT queries, the reported mean relative reductions in output Collision are 12.8% and 10.8%, respectively. We also instantiate the framework for generative engine optimization over four product markets and for iterative synthetic-data augmentation. In the latter setting, with 100 training examples per method, Gap Detection reduces Collision from 0.324 to 0.298 relative to undirected accumulation and increases the Vendi Score from 27.16 to 29.20; the accuracy difference is one example on a 40-example test set. Component ablations expose the trade-off between semantic separation and relevance, while also showing that better direction scores do not uniformly yield better downstream metrics. These results support explicit gap search as a practical mechanism for diversifying content, with task validity checked separately from geometric novelty.
blocks.zh: 语言模型往往对开放式问题产生极为相似的答案,即使存在许多可行的替代办法。 产生有用的替代方法需要既确定查询要求什么,也确定现有答复已经涵盖哪些内容。 我们引入了漏洞检测,这个框架在共享文本嵌入空间中搜索相关但未使用的方向. 其目标GapScore将查询关联性(Demand)与距离最近的现有项目(defensibility)的异构性结合起来. 框架在单位域上优化了这个产品,用语言模型绘制了概念词的候选方向,并使用特定任务过滤和受约束的提示来将这些概念转化为文字. 关于5个归口专题和90个INFINITY-CHAT查询,所报告的产出碰撞的平均相对减少率分别为12.8%和10.8%。 我们还对四个产品市场进行基因引擎优化和迭代合成数据增强框架进行即时分析。 在后一种情况下,每方法100个培训实例,差距探测将碰撞从0.324降至0.298,并将Vendi分数从27.16增至29.20;准确性差是40个实例测试集的一个实例。 构成部分的叠加暴露了语义分离与相关性之间的权衡,同时也表明,更好的方向分数不能统一产生更好的下游指标。 这些结果支持明确寻找差距,作为内容多样化的实际机制,任务有效性与几何新颖性分开检查。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Open-ended questions invite multiple reasonable answers, yet language models frequently return variations of the same idea. A request for a metaphor about time, for example, can repeatedly elicit familiar images such as rivers or weaving. This pattern has been documented within and across models using INFINITY-CHAT, a collection of real-world open-ended queries ( Jiang et al.,, 2025 ) . Reference-free diversity metrics such as the Vendi Score likewise quantify the small effective number of semantic modes in such sets ( Friedman & Dieng,, 2023 ) . For a user seeking alternative perspectives, lexical variation is insufficient: answers must differ in substance while continuing to address the question.
blocks.zh: 开放式的问题吸引了多种合理的答案,但语言模型往往会回溯同一想法的变异. 例如,对时间的比喻请求可以反复地引出熟悉的图像,如河流或编织. 使用INFINITY-CHAT记录了这种模式在模型内部和模型之间的情况,这是一套现实世界的开放式查询(Jiang等,2025年)。 Vendi Score等无参考多样性衡量标准同样量化了这类组合中语义模式的少量有效数量(Friedman & Dieng, 2023年)。 对于寻求另类观点的用户来说,词法差异是不够的:答案在实质上必须不同,同时继续处理这一问题。

blocks.en: This problem suggests a distinction between sampling another answer and identifying an answer that is missing. Changing the decoding distribution can alter which tokens are sampled, but it does not explicitly represent the semantic content already covered by a collection of responses. Existing diversity-aware methods such as Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) trade query relevance against redundancy when reranking a fixed candidate set ( Carbonell & Goldstein,, 1998 ) ; learning-to-rank methods likewise score those candidates ( Liu,, 2009 ) . Neither formulation searches unoccupied semantic space. Conversely, maximizing distance from previous responses alone can produce irrelevant concepts. A useful method must therefore keep new content connected to the user’s demand while avoiding the nearest existing answer.
blocks.zh: 这个问题表明,在取样另一个答案和确定一个缺失的答案之间有区别。 改变解码分布可以改变哪些符号被取出样本,但它并不明确代表一个响应集合已经覆盖的语义内容. 现有的多样性认识方法,如最大边际相关性(MMR)贸易在对固定候选人进行重新排位时询问与冗余的相关性(Carbonell & Goldstein,1998年);学习与排名方法同样对这些候选人进行评分(Liu,2009年)。 两种配方都无法搜索未占用的语义空间 。 反之,仅与以往的对策相距最大,就可能产生无关的概念。 因此,一种有用的方法必须保持新内容与用户需求的联系,同时避免最近的现有答案。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we introduce Gap Detection , a framework for discovering and realizing unoccupied semantic directions. Given a query and an occupied content set, the framework embeds both in a shared vector space ( Mikolov et al.,, 2013 ) , then searches for directions with high GapScore : the product of Demand (query relevance) and Defensibility (separation from the nearest occupied item). Directions are selected sequentially and added to the occupied set, so later searches account explicitly for earlier coverage.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了“差距探测”这个发现和实现无占用语义方向的框架。 鉴于一个查询和一个被占用的内容集,这个框架同时嵌入一个共享矢量空间(Mikolov等人,2013年),然后搜索具有高差距分数的方向:Demand(query relence)和Defensibility(与最近被占用的项目分离)的产品. 方向按顺序选择并添加到被占用的集中,因此后期的搜索账户明确了之前的覆盖.

blocks.en: A high-scoring vector, however, is not yet a usable answer. Gap Detection bridges this gap through language-based realization. Embedding retrieval supplies a short list of words near a discovered direction; Qwen selects concepts that can answer the query, and a second filter checks their contextual plausibility. A text generator then uses these concepts while being prompted to avoid frequent concepts and sentence patterns in existing responses. Finally, the generated text is evaluated for novelty and repetition. The geometric search identifies where to explore, while the mapping and validation stages determine whether the proposed direction can be expressed as meaningful content.
blocks.zh: 然而,高分矢量还不是可用答案。 差距检测通过基于语言的实现来弥补这一差距. Embedding reference 提供了一个靠近已发现方向的简短的单词列表;Quen选择了能够回答查询的概念,第二个过滤器检查其上下文的可信度. 然后,一个文本生成器会使用这些概念,同时被激发以避免在现有响应中频繁出现的概念和句子模式. 最后,对生成的文本进行新颖和重复的评价。 几何搜索确定了可探索之处,而绘图和验证阶段则确定拟议方向是否可以被表述为有意义的内容.

blocks.en: The same relevance–coverage distinction appears beyond open-ended answering. In generative engine optimization (GEO), a candidate position should address user needs while differing from competitors’ claims; GEO work shows that supplied content can affect which sources a generative engine cites ( Aggarwal et al.,, 2024 ) . Recursive training on generated data can reduce diversity ( Shumailov et al.,, 2024 ; Alemohammad et al.,, 2024 ) , whereas retaining real and synthetic data can alter that trajectory ( Gerstgrasser et al.,, 2024 ) . We study these as separate instantiations of the same objective, with setting-specific inputs, validity checks, and evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 同样的关联性----覆盖性区别似乎超出了开放式答复的范围。 在基因引擎优化(GEO)中,候选职位应满足用户需求,同时不同于竞争对手的主张;GEO的研究表明,所提供的内容会影响基因引擎引用的哪些来源(Aggarwal等,2024年)。 关于生成数据的回溯性培训可减少多样性(Shumailov等,2024;Alemohammad等,2024;而保留真实和合成数据可改变这一轨迹(Gerstgrasser等,2024)。 我们将这些研究作为同一目标的单独即时分析,并附有具体投入、有效性检查和评价标准。

blocks.en: Experiments examine both the effectiveness and the limits of this design. The reported mean relative Collision reduction is 12.8% over five curated topics and 10.8% over 90 open-ended queries. Additional experiments vary the source of the occupied responses and the model used to realize new directions. In four product markets, discovered positions receive citations in a controlled generative-engine simulation. In a small sentiment-data experiment, directed augmentation improves diversity relative to an accumulation baseline at the same final sample count. Ablations show that the product objective improves its intended relevance–separation score, but the full pipeline does not dominate every output-level metric.
blocks.zh: 实验研究了这种设计的效果和极限. 据报告,平均相对碰撞减少12.8%,涉及5个主题,10.8%,涉及90个开放式问题。 额外的实验则会改变被占用的响应的来源以及用于实现新方向的模型. 在四个产品市场中,发现的位置在受控基因引擎模拟中得到引用。 在一个小的情感数据实验中,定向增强比同一最终样本计数的积累基线提高多样性. 偏差表明,产品目标提高了预期的相关性-分离分数,但整个管道并不支配每个产出级别的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • A coverage-aware objective. We formulate gap discovery as joint optimization of Demand and Defensibility relative to an explicit occupied set. • A search-to-text pipeline. We combine spherical optimization, language-model concept mapping, and task-specific validation so that a geometric direction is tested before it is accepted as content. • A cross-setting evaluation. We evaluate the pipeline across open-ended generation, GEO positioning, and synthetic-data augmentation, reporting component trade-offs alongside aggregate gains. Appendix A provides the geometric existence result, conditional optimization results, and their proofs; the main text focuses on how the method operates and what the experiments establish.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work shows that semantically repetitive outputs persist across model families and decoding configurations ( Jiang et al.,, 2025 ) . These findings motivate evaluating similarity at the level of complete responses. We use mean pairwise embedding similarity, termed Collision here, and complement it with the Vendi Score, a spectral measure of diversity ( Friedman & Dieng,, 2023 ) . Gap Detection uses the occupied responses as an input to generation, rather than only as an evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究表明,在模范家庭和解码配置中,大量重复的产出持续存在(Jiang等,2025年)。 这些结果促使人们评价在完整答复层面的相似性。 我们使用平均双相嵌入相似性, 这里称为碰撞, 并以 Vendi 分数作为补充, 差距探测使用被占用的响应作为对生成的投入,而不仅仅是作为评价集.

blocks.en: Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) balances query relevance against similarity to previously selected documents ( Carbonell & Goldstein,, 1998 ) . Gap Detection shares this redundancy-aware perspective. Its differences are a multiplicative objective, continuous search over embedding directions, and a realization stage that generates new text rather than only reordering existing documents. The product avoids an additive trade-off coefficient, but the complete pipeline still contains optimization and filtering hyperparameters. Prompted avoidance of repeated words is related to lexical constraints ( Hokamp & Liu,, 2017 ) ; unlike constrained decoding, our prompts do not guarantee that the generator obeys every constraint.
blocks.zh: 最大边际相关性(MMR)平衡了查询相关性与以前选定的文件的相似性(Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998.). Gap Detection 共享这种冗余意识视角 。 它的区别是多重目标,在嵌入方向之上持续搜索,以及生成新文本而不是仅仅重排现有文档的实现阶段. 产品避免了添加剂的取舍系数,但整个管道仍然包含优化和过滤超参数. 被迅速避免重复的单词与词典限制有关(Hokamp & Liu, 2017);与受约束的解码不同,我们的提示不能保证生成者服从每一个约束.

blocks.en: GEO studies how source content influences its visibility in generated answers ( Aggarwal et al.,, 2024 ) . We consider an earlier decision: which plausible position should new content express relative to existing claims? Separately, recursive synthetic-data training can degrade generative distributions ( Shumailov et al.,, 2024 ; Alemohammad et al.,, 2024 ) , while retaining real and past synthetic data can mitigate collapse in studied settings ( Gerstgrasser et al.,, 2024 ) . Our augmentation experiment asks whether directing new samples toward semantic gaps adds value beyond retaining more samples. The documented procedure evaluates generated text with a downstream classifier and does not specify generative-model retraining, so it tests a narrower setting.
blocks.zh: GEO研究源内容如何影响其在生成的答案中的能见度(Aggarwal等人,2024年)。 我们认为早些时候的决定是:新内容应表达与现有主张相比的哪些合理立场? 另外,递归合成数据培训可降解基因分布(Shumailov等,2024;Alemohammad等,2024),同时保留真实和过去的合成数据可减轻研究环境中的崩溃。 (Gerstgrasser等,2024年). 我们的增强实验 问将新的样本引向语义差距 是否不仅能增加保留更多样本的价值 所记录的程序用下游分级器评价生成的文本,没有指定基因模型再培训,因此测试范围更窄.

blocks.en: The output is a collection of proposed directions and their textual realizations. The procedure has four stages: represent demand and occupied content; search for directions that balance relevance and separation; map the directions to plausible concepts; and generate and check text. These stages address different failure modes. Search discourages repetition, concept mapping makes vectors interpretable, and validation rejects directions or outputs that do not satisfy the task. We describe the shared mechanism first and then specify its domain adaptations.
blocks.zh: 产出是拟议方向及其文字实现的集合. 该程序分为四个阶段:代表需求和占用内容;寻找在相关性和分离性之间取得平衡的方向;将方向绘制成合理概念;生成并检查文本。 这些阶段涉及不同的故障模式。 搜索阻止了重复,概念映射使矢量可以被解释,验证拒绝不满足任务的方向或输出. 我们首先描述共享机制,然后具体说明其域调整。

The pipeline embeds existing content and the query, searches the unit hypersphere for a high-GapScore direction, maps that direction to a concrete concept, and verifies the resulting candidate before accepting it. A rejected candidate triggers another search; an accepted direction is added to the occupied set so later directions cover a different region.

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the search-to-text interface. The occupied set and query enter the same embedding space, while only the direction is passed to the concept stage through retrieved candidate words. The verifier closes the loop: it checks coherence, task relevance, and novelty, then either returns an accepted output or feeds the rejection back into the next direction search. This separation makes it possible to diagnose whether a failure comes from geometric search, concept mapping, or realization.

blocks.en: For nonnegative Demand, the product rewards both relevance and separation and vanishes when either is zero. Directions with negative Demand receive nonpositive scores. Thus, an empty region is not automatically desirable: it must also align with demand. The product can still trade off two positive factors, so it supplies a preference rather than a hard lower bound on either factor. Appendix A.3 discusses its connection to bargaining objectives under explicit assumptions.
blocks.zh: 对于非负需求,产品既奖励相关性,也奖励分离,当两者均为零时,产品就会消失。 需求方向得到非正数。 因此,一个空地地区并非自动可取:它也必须与需求相适应。 产品仍然可以交换两个积极因素,因此它提供一种偏好,而不是对任一因素的更下限。 附录A.3讨论了它在明确假设下与谈判目标的联系。

blocks.en: Demand-only optimization ignores the occupied set, whereas Defensibility-only optimization can leave the query. Their product couples relevance and separation; concept and output checks then supply the task-specific validity test.
blocks.zh: 只有需求优化忽略了被占用的集,而只有Defensibility的优化则可以离开查询. 它们的产品配对的相关性和分离性;然后进行概念和产出检查,提供具体任务的有效性测试。

If demand has a nonzero component orthogonal to the span of occupied content, normalizing that component gives a direction with Defensibility exactly one and positive Demand. This yields a lower bound on the best achievable geometric score. It does not guarantee that a corresponding natural-language answer exists. The precise condition, proof, and numerical comparison are in Appendix A.1 ; the language stages below remain necessary even when the bound holds.
blocks.zh: 几何学也提供了一个有用的诊断. 如果需求有一个非零成份正对被占用内容的跨度,那么该成份的正常化就给出了一个具有完全一个和正值的防御性的方向。 这在最佳可实现的几何分数上产生更低的下限. 它不能保证相应的自然语言答案存在. 确切的条件、证明和数字比较载于附录A.1;即使约束存在,下列语文阶段仍有必要。

blocks.en: 3.4 Mapping Directions to Plausible Concepts
blocks.zh: 3.4 将方向绘制成可扩展概念

blocks.en: A direction must be translated into concepts before a generator can use it. We construct a vocabulary from the Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct tokenizer, filter it to 13,409 English words, and embed these words with the same encoder used for the content. A query- and corpus-dependent screening score retains 10,000 words. For each direction, cosine retrieval then selects 20 unused candidate words near that direction. This screening is computational; it does not decide whether a word answers the query.
blocks.zh: 一个方向必须在生成器使用之前被转化为概念. 我们从 Quen2.5-3B 指示符号中构建一个词汇, 过滤到 13 409 个英文单词, 并将这些单词嵌入到内容所用的编码器中 。 以查询和调查为主的筛选分数保留了一万个字。 对每个方向,余弦检索然后在该方向附近选择20个未使用的候选词. 这种筛选是计算;它不会决定一个词是否回答了查询.

blocks.en: Qwen receives the query and the candidate words and selects up to three concepts that could form concrete answers. GPT-4o-mini subsequently checks whether the selected concepts fit the requested kind of answer, including whether a proposed word merely restates the query. If fewer than three words pass, the pipeline examines further candidates, with at most ten rounds. Accepted words are not reused across directions. Appendix B gives the vocabulary score and candidate-handling details, and Appendix F gives the available prompt templates.
blocks.zh: Quen接收了询问和候选词并选择了最多能形成具体答案的三个概念. GPT-4o-mini随后检查了所选概念是否适合所要求的答案类型,包括拟议中的单词是否仅仅重复了查询. 如果少于三个字通过,管道将审查更多的候选人,最多十轮。 接受的单词不会被跨方向再使用 。 附 录 B给出了词汇分数和候选处理细节,附录F给出了可用的即时模板.

blocks.en: This separation matters because geometric proximity and linguistic usefulness are different tests. A nearby token may be a synonym of the question rather than an answer to it; a highly separated token may be unrelated to the task. The language-model stages evaluate these distinctions after the embedding search. They provide a plausibility screen, not a correctness certificate.
blocks.zh: 这种分离很重要,因为几何相近和语言实用性是不同的测试. 相邻的标志可能是问题同义词而不是答案;高度分离的标志可能与任务无关. 语言模型阶段在嵌入搜索后评价这些区别. 它们提供可信屏幕,而不是正确性证明.

blocks.en: 3.5 Generating and Checking Text
blocks.zh: 3.5 生成和检查文本

blocks.en: For each accepted concept group, GPT-4o-mini generates one sentence conditioned on the original query. The prompt also includes two kinds of avoidance instructions derived from the occupied content. First, the pipeline identifies 12 frequent words close to the occupied-content centroid and asks the generator to avoid them. Second, it extracts recurring sentence patterns and asks for a different construction. Concept guidance specifies what to express, while these instructions discourage a return to the content and phrasing already represented in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} .
blocks.zh: 对于每个被接受的概念组,GPT-4o-mini生成一个以原始查询为条件的句子. 提示书还包括从被占用内容中衍生出来的两种撤销指令. 首先,管道识别出12个与被占用的内涵中间体相近的频繁字,并要求生成器避免. 第二,它摘录了反复出现的句子模式,并要求另作构建. 概念指导指定了要表达什么,而这些指示则阻碍返回C\mathcal{C}中已经表示的内容和措辞.

blocks.en: The realized sentences are embedded again. A novelty check requires the maximum similarity to the original occupied responses to be below 0.7. A separate check compares opening words, and another checks whether the maximum pairwise similarity among the new sentences is below 0.8. The opening-word check is lexical; the two similarity checks are semantic proxies. Neither establishes human-perceived creativity or factual accuracy. Measuring the realized text is necessary because a generator may move away from the direction suggested by its concept words.
blocks.zh: 已实现的句子又被嵌入了. 新颖性的检查要求与原被占用的响应的最大相似度低于0.7. 一个单独的检查比较开口词,另一个检查新句子的最大对等相似度是否低于0.8. 开口字检查为词典;两种相似性检查为语义代词. 也没有确立人所见的创造力或事实准确性。 测量已实现的文本是必要的,因为生成器可能偏离其概念词所建议的方向.

blocks.en: The concept words form an inspectable intermediate representation: a failure can be attributed to direction search, concept selection, or sentence realization.
blocks.zh: 概念词构成可检查的中间代表: 失败可归因于方向搜索,概念选择,或句子实现.

blocks.en: 3.6 Adapting the Framework to GEO and Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: 3.6 使框架适应全球环境展望和合成数据

blocks.en: The occupied set becomes a collection of competitor product claims, and demand consists of weighted search queries. The concept filter asks whether a candidate is plausible within the product category; the generator turns accepted words into a proposed claim. A controlled citation simulation then measures its visibility. Candidate claims are ranked by direction GapScore multiplied by the visibility score. Because the framework does not receive the target product’s specifications, its output is a proposed market position requiring factual verification before use.
blocks.zh: 被占用的套件成为竞争者产品索赔的集合,需求由加权搜索查询组成. 概念过滤器询问一个候选人在产品类别中是否合理;生成者将接受的词变为拟议索赔。 受控的引用模拟然后测量其能见度. 候选人申请按方向排序 差距分数乘以能见度分数。 由于该框架没有得到目标产品的规格,因此其产出是一种拟议的市场地位,在使用前需要实际核实。

blocks.en: The occupied set becomes the current synthetic sample pool, and task-class descriptions with class-frequency weights specify demand. The concept filter checks task relevance, and the generator creates labeled examples. For sentiment classification, VADER ( Hutto & Gilbert,, 2014 ) supplies an additional polarity check: compound scores above 0.05 pass as positive and below − 0.05 -0.05 as negative. Candidate words are also reranked by absolute polarity. Directed methods retry generation up to four rounds to reach the accepted-example target. Final comparisons use K = 1 K=1 per label and generation; a separate direction-set analysis uses K = 3 K=3 . The downstream classifier is trained on the resulting data and evaluated on a disjoint real test set. Its accuracy is an outcome measure, not an input to direction selection.
blocks.zh: 被占用的集会成为目前的合成样本池,具有类频权重的任务类描述会指定需求. 概念过滤检查任务关联性,生成器创建被标记的示例. 关于情绪分类,VADER(Hutto & Gilbert,2014年)提供了额外的极性检查:复数高于0.05的分数为正分,低于0.05-0.05的分数为负分. 候选词也被绝对极性重新排行. 定向方法再试生成可达4发,以达到被接受-实例目标. 最终比较使用K=每个标签和生成1K=1;单独的方向集分析使用K=3K=3. 下游的分类人员接受有关由此产生的数据的培训,并在一个脱节的真正测试集中进行评估。 它的准确性是一种结果衡量,而不是对方向选择的投入.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We ask whether Gap Detection reduces repetition in realized outputs, how each score component affects the result, and whether the search mechanism remains useful when the occupied content changes from responses to claims or training examples. The three settings share the embedding and search machinery but use separate task-specific evaluation protocols.

blocks.en: 4.2 Open-Ended Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 不限成员名额的一代

blocks.en: The topic study uses five manually selected themes, with five query variants per theme and 20 GPT-4o responses as the occupied set. A second study uses 90 manually selected INFINITY-CHAT queries. Five directions and corresponding sentences are produced for each query. Table 1 summarizes the before/after Collision measurements. Detailed query-group results and reporting qualifications are given in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 专题研究采用5个人工选择的主题,每个主题有5个查询变体,20个GPT-4o响应作为占用的一组. 第二项研究使用90个人工选择的INFINITY-CHAT查询. 每个查询都产生五个方向和相应的句子. 表1总结了碰撞前后的测量结果。 详细查询组结果和报告资格载于附录C。

blocks.en: All five topics exhibit lower reported Collision, with reductions from 10.7% to 17.9%. The 90-query experiment shows a similar aggregate pattern, with Collision decreasing from 0.7766 to 0.6915 and a largest single-query reduction of 20.5%. The best sentence passes the novelty threshold on 88 of 90 queries (97.8%). These observations indicate separation from existing responses under the chosen encoder; they do not establish that the sentences are better answers according to human judgments.

blocks.en: The study does not include a matched rerun of temperature or min- p p baselines. The decoding experiments in prior work ( Jiang et al.,, 2025 ) provide motivation, but their results are not a controlled numerical baseline for this pipeline. Likewise, direction search, concept filtering, and avoidance prompting contribute jointly to the observed end-to-end change. The ablation below isolates the direction-selection rule within that shared pipeline.
blocks.zh: 研究不包括相应的再运行温度或分钟-p基线。 前作中的解码实验(Jiang等人,2025年)提供了动力,但其结果并不是这一管道的可控数字基线. 同样地,方向搜索、概念过滤和避免促使共同促进观察到的端到端变化。 下面的删减将方向选择规则隔离在共享管道内.

blocks.en: We compare random directions, Demand-only search, Defensibility-only search, and the product objective on five topics (Table 2 ). GapScore achieves the highest direction score, 0.375, compared with 0.298 for Demand-only and − 0.228 -0.228 for Defensibility-only. However, Defensibility-only achieves the largest Collision reduction, and random directions achieve the highest novelty-check pass rate. The full method’s pass rate is 84% in this separate ablation. Thus, both terms help balance the geometric objective, but the ablation does not establish uniform superiority in realized-text metrics. The relatively strong random-direction result also suggests that the shared filtering and prompting stages make a substantial contribution.

blocks.en: 4.3 Transfer across Content Sources and Generators
blocks.zh: 4.3 内容来源和发电机之间的转移

blocks.en: The occupied responses and the realization model affect different stages of Gap Detection. Changing the source of existing responses changes which directions the search must avoid. Changing the realization model instead tests how effectively a discovered direction is turned into text. We evaluate these dependencies separately on three topics.
blocks.zh: 被占用的响应与实现模型会影响差距探测的不同阶段. 更改搜索必须避免的现有答复来源。 更改实现模式,以测试一个发现的方向是如何有效地变成文字的。 我们分别在三个专题上评估这些依赖性。

blocks.en: Each of four models supplies its own set of 20 occupied responses, while GPT-4o-mini remains the realization model. Collision decreases for every source (Table 11 ), with reported reductions of 8.8–12.7% and a mean of 10.4%. The novelty-pass rate averages 96.7%. This result supports using the same search and realization procedure across the tested content sources; it does not require the occupied responses to come from the generator that will produce the new answer.
blocks.zh: 4个模型中每个都提供自己的20个被占据的响应集,而GPT-4o-mini仍然是实现模型. 每个来源的碰撞减少(表11),据报告减少8.8至12.7%,平均减少10.4%。 新出道率平均为96.7%. 这个结果支持在被测试的内容源中使用相同的搜索和实现程序;它不需要被占用的响应来自生成新答案的生成器.

blocks.en: The separate-source study reports reductions of 11.2% (GPT-4o-mini), 12.7% (Claude-Sonnet-4.5), 8.8% (Gemini-2.0-Flash), and 8.8% (Qwen2.5-3B), averaging 10.4% with a 96.7% novelty-pass rate. The complete table is in Appendix C.2 .
blocks.zh: 独立来源研究报告的下降率为:11.2%(GPT-4o-mini)、12.7%(Claude-Sonnet-4.5)、8.8%(Gemini-2.0-Flash)和8.8%(Quen2.5-3B),平均为10.4%,通过率为96.7%。 完整的表格见附录C.2。

blocks.en: A mixed-source experiment combines five responses from each of these four models into one occupied set. Its recorded Collision values are 0.602 before intervention and 0.561 afterward, with a reported reduction of 7.4%. This tests whether the search can account for content contributed by several models simultaneously; supplementary source-similarity diagnostics are in Appendix C.2 .
blocks.zh: 一个混合源实验将这四个模型中每个模型的五个响应组合为一个被占用的集合. 其记录的碰撞值在干预前为0.602,之后为0.561,据报告下降了7.4%。 这种测试标准是,搜索是否能够同时说明几个模型提供的内容;补充源-同源性诊断见附录C.2。

blocks.en: With 20 GPT-4o-mini responses held fixed as the occupied set, the reported Collision reduction is 9.0% for GPT-4o-mini, 11.6% for GPT-4o, and 14.8% for Claude-Sonnet-4.5, with novelty-pass rates of 80.0%, 100.0%, and 100.0%. The search can therefore be robust to the source set while remaining sensitive to how a direction is expressed. These output comparisons do not establish a general ranking of model quality.
blocks.zh: 由于有20个GPT-4-mini反应被固定为占用的一组,报告的碰撞减少率为:GPT-4-mini为9.0%,GPT-4o为11.6%,Claude-Sonnet-4.5为14.8%,新式通过率为:80.0%、100.0%和100.0%。 因此,搜索可以对源集进行有力,同时对一个方向的表达方式保持敏感. 这些产出比较没有建立模型质量的一般排名.

blocks.en: 4.4 GEO Market Positioning
blocks.zh: 4.4 全球环境展望 市场定位

blocks.en: We use Amazon product metadata ( Hou et al.,, 2024 ) for water filters, protein powder, sports water bottles, and yoga mats. Grouping claims by brand and filtering sparse brands leaves 3–17 brands and 12–142 claims per market. Each market has 15 manually designed, weighted search queries. The method searches for five directions and realizes them as proposed claims.
blocks.zh: 我们使用亚马逊产品元数据(Hou等人,2024年)来进行水过滤,蛋白质粉,运动水瓶和瑜伽垫. 通过品牌和过滤稀有品牌进行分组索赔,每个市场留下3至17个品牌和12至142个索赔。 每个市场都有15个人工设计的加权搜索查询. 方法搜索出五个方向并实现它们为拟议索赔.

blocks.en: The selected positions have a reported mean product score of 0.221 (Table 3 ). For water filters, the words campground, wilderness, hike express an outdoor-use direction; its GapScore is 0.410 and PAWC is 0.518. A more generic direction, screened, cleansing, reservoir , has a higher PAWC of 0.544 but a lower GapScore of 0.135, giving a smaller product of 0.073. This example illustrates the intended distinction between being cited and identifying a differentiated position.

The evidence therefore supports better joint relevance–separation scoring in this simulation, rather than a standalone visibility advantage. Complete market factors, concept words, and water-filter directions are in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 在单独的减分中,"GapScore"产品得分最高,仅以需求计0.149比0.143,而"仅需求"产品得分最高,为0.508比0.482. 因此,证据支持在这种模拟中更好的联合相关性-分离分数,而不是一个单独的能见度优势。 完整的市场因素、概念词和取水器方向载于附录D。

blocks.en: The factors expose the market trade-off: protein powder has Demand 0.383 and Defensibility 1.249, while yoga mats have Demand 0.763 and Defensibility 0.528. Defensibility above one does not verify a product property.
blocks.zh: 这些因素暴露出市场取舍:蛋白质粉有"需求"0.383和"防御"1.249;而瑜伽垫有"需求"0.763和"防御"0.528. 一个以上的可防御性不核查产品财产。

blocks.en: 4.5 Iterative Synthetic-Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: 4.5 迭代合成-数据增强

blocks.en: We use SST-2 sentiment examples ( Socher et al.,, 2013 ) , with ten seed examples per class and a disjoint test slice of twenty examples per class. Across five generation rounds, accumulation methods target eight additional accepted examples per class per round. A TF-IDF logistic-regression classifier is trained on each round’s data. The final comparison has 100 training examples per method. No Intervention replaces the preceding pool with newly generated text; Data Accumulation retains prior data and adds undirected samples; GapScore retains prior data and adds directed samples with the filtering in Section 3.6 . These are controlled baselines inspired by replacement and accumulation studies, not exact replications of their model-training protocols.
blocks.zh: 我们使用SST-2情绪例子(Socher等,2013年),每类有10个种子例子,每类有20个例子的脱节测试切片. 在五代回合中,积累方法针对每轮课次增加八个公认的例子。 对TF-IDF后勤后退分类员进行了每轮数据的培训。 最后比较每个方法有100个培训实例。 没有干预用新生成的文本来取代前一个集合; 数据积累保留了先前的数据并添加了未定向的样本; GapScore保留了先前的数据并添加了第3.6节中过滤的定向样本. 这些都是由替换和积累研究所启发的控制基线,而不是其示范训练规程的精确复制.

blocks.en: Table 4: Synthetic-data results at generation five. All three methods have 100 training examples. Accuracy is evaluated on 40 disjoint real examples; the 2.5-point difference corresponds to one prediction.
blocks.zh: 表4:第五代合成数据结果。 所有三种方法都有100个培训实例。 准确性通过40个脱节的实际例子来评价;2.5分的差值相当于一个预测.

blocks.en: GapScore lowers Collision from 0.324 to 0.298 relative to Data Accumulation and raises Vendi from 27.16 to 29.20 (Table 4 ). Its 62.5% accuracy exceeds the two baselines’ 60.0% by one test example. This is a positive point estimate in a small task, not evidence of a statistically reliable accuracy gain. Matching accepted sample counts also does not match API-call budgets: directed generation may make additional calls when candidates fail the polarity check.
blocks.zh: 相较于数据积累,差距分数从0.324降至0.298,将文迪从27.16提高到29.20(表4)。 其62.5%的精度通过一个测试例子超过了两个基线的60.0%。 这是一个小任务中的正点估计,而不是统计上可靠的准确性增益的证据. 匹配被接受的样本计数也不符合API调用预算:定向生成在候选人不通过极性检查时可能会发出额外呼叫.

blocks.en: Separate four-generator runs show lower Collision for GapScore than accumulation in all four cases, with differences between − 0.019 -0.019 and − 0.028 -0.028 . Vendi improves in three cases, but decreases by 0.74 for Qwen2.5-3B. These reruns have different numerical deltas from Table 4 ; they are reported separately in Appendix E . No model-wise downstream accuracy table is available for these reruns. The results support a recurring reduction in average similarity, while exposing a case where spectral diversity moves in the opposite direction.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The central result is that an explicit representation of prior content can guide a language pipeline toward less repetitive outputs. The method separates three questions: where the occupied set leaves room, whether a concept fits the task, and whether its realization is useful. The ablations show why those questions should remain separate. Better geometric scores can coexist with weaker novelty-check rates or lower citation share; direction optimization alone does not explain all end-to-end gains.
blocks.zh: 中心结果是,对先前内容的明确表述可以指导一种语言管道实现较少重复的产出。 该方法分离出三个问题:被占用的套集留有空间的地方,一个概念是否适合任务,以及它的实现是否有用. 浮出水面表明为什么这些问题应该分开。 更好的几何分数可以与更弱的新奇检查率或更低的引用份额并存;方向优化本身并不能解释所有端到端收益.

blocks.en: The evaluation has several limits. Collision and Vendi depend on the encoder used for both search and evaluation, and no independent human assessment of answer quality is reported. The query subset is manually selected. Some aggregation details remain unresolved in the experimental record, and raw outputs and repeated-run uncertainty are needed for a complete replication. GEO results use fixed source positions in a simulation, do not test live retrieval, and do not verify that a proposed claim is true of a target product. Sparse markets can also make apparent gaps easier to find. Finally, the sentiment study uses a small seed and test set, a lightweight classifier, and no documented generator-retraining procedure; it does not establish prevention of collapse in recursively retrained foundation models. VADER filtering may favor simple polarity cues, and matched training-set sizes do not isolate its effect from direction selection.
blocks.zh: 评估有若干限制。 碰撞和文迪都依赖于用于搜索和评价的编码器,没有报告对答案质量进行独立的人类评估. 手动选择查询子集 。 一些汇总细节在实验记录中仍未解决,需要原始产出和重复运行的不确定性才能完全复制。 GEO结果在模拟中使用固定源位,不测试活取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 小规模市场还可以使明显差距更容易找到。 最后,情绪研究使用一个小种子和测试集,一个轻量级分级器,并且没有记录的发电机-再训练程序;它没有在递归再训练的基础模型中建立防止倒塌的功能. VADER 过滤可能倾向于简单的极性提示,匹配的训练集大小不会将其效果与方向选择相隔离.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Gap Detection makes prior semantic coverage an explicit input to generation. It combines Demand and Defensibility to search for directions, maps them to concepts, and uses task-specific checks to realize them as text. The reported experiments show lower Collision across the open-ended generation studies and useful diversity gains in a small augmentation task, with a GEO study illustrating differentiated position discovery. The mixed ablations also identify the remaining challenge: translating a well-separated, relevant direction into content whose quality improves under independent evaluation.
blocks.zh: 差距探测使前语义覆盖成为生成的明确输入. 它将需求与可防御性结合起来,以寻找方向,将它们映射到概念上,并使用特定任务检查实现它们作为文本. 所报告的实验表明,在不限成员名额的一代研究中,碰撞程度较低,在小型扩增任务中,多样性有了有益的增加,地球观测组织的一项研究说明了不同位置的发现。 混合的拼图还查明了仍然存在的挑战:将一个相互分隔的、相关的方向转化为独立评估下质量得到改善的内容。

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools for several assistive purposes. We used them to run parts of the experimental pipeline (executing the embedding, search, mapping, and verification steps of the method and collecting the resulting metrics), to retrieve and discover related work (identifying and locating candidate citations for concepts and comparisons already determined by the authors), to draft and polish sections of the manuscript’s writing (producing initial phrasing for some passages and improving clarity, wording, and consistency of the prose), and to check the derivations underlying the propositions and theorem in Appendix A against standard results after the authors formulated the claims. We have not used generative AI tools to design the core method or decide which results to report; those decisions were made by the authors, and no other disclosure items from the ICLR AI Policy apply to this work. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work: we checked that AI-run experiments used the intended settings and reproduced consistent numbers across repeated runs, we verified that every AI-suggested citation is accurate and genuinely relevant to the point it supports, we independently re-derived the proof steps that AI helped check, and we verified that the drafted and polished prose preserved the original meaning without introducing unsupported claims. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, and artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们使用基因AI工具用于几个辅助目的. 我们用它们来操作实验管道的部分内容(执行方法的嵌入、搜索、绘图和核查步骤并收集由此得出的指标),检索和发现相关工作(查明和查找作者已经确定的概念和比较的候选引文),起草和整理手稿的部分内容(编写一些段落的初步措辞并改进文字的清晰度、措辞和一致性),并在作者提出主张后对照标准结果检查附录A中主张和定理的出处。 我们没有使用基因AI工具来设计核心方法或决定哪些结果可以报告;这些决定是由作者作出的,而《ICLR AI政策》中的其他披露项目也不适用于这项工作。 我们审查了所有AI协助的工作:我们检查了AI运行的实验使用了预定的设置,并在多次运行中重复了一致的数字,我们核实了每个AI推荐的引用都准确,与它所支持的点真正相关,我们独立地重新提出了AI帮助检查的证明步骤,我们核实了所起草和抛光的传言保留了原意,而没有提出无根据的主张. 我们对这项工作的最后内容负责,包括文本、权利主张和在基因AI的帮助下生产的文物。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The reported evaluations use existing datasets and controlled generated content. The GEO experiment evaluates proposed claims in a citation simulation; a plausibility filter does not establish that a real product has the proposed properties. Any deployment would require factual verification. Similarly, semantic novelty does not imply that an answer is safe, correct, or useful. Dataset licenses, privacy requirements, and provider terms must be respected when distributing the data and generated examples. The sentiment experiment trains a small downstream classifier and should not be interpreted as validation of a deployed model.
blocks.zh: 所报告的评价利用现有的数据集和控制生成的内容。 地球同步轨道实验在引用模拟中评价了拟议索赔;一个合理性过滤器不能确定一个真正的产品具有拟议属性。 任何部署都需要核实事实。 同样,语义新奇并不意味着一个答案是安全的、正确的或有用的。 在分发数据和生成实例时,必须尊重数据集许可证、隐私要求和提供者条件。 情绪实验训练出一个小下游分类器,不应被解释为对所部署的模型的验证.

blocks.en: This appendix collects all formal results and proofs. The geometric statements concern vectors in an embedding space. They do not establish that every such vector can be realized as valid text. Results borrowed from smooth optimization and submodular maximization are stated with their additional assumptions, rather than applied unconditionally to the implemented search.

blocks.en: The product has two elementary properties on the positive region: a zero factor gives zero score, and multiplying either factor by a positive constant preserves the ranking of candidates. These facts motivate its use without claiming invariance to arbitrary translations of either factor.

blocks.en: At a point with a unique active neighbor, Eq. ( 4 ) is the ordinary gradient. At a tie, an active branch gives a generalized derivative choice, consistent with nonsmooth analysis ( Clarke,, 1983 ) . The fixed-step implementation remains a multistart heuristic for a nonsmooth objective, in the spirit of stochastic multi-start global optimization ( Rinnooy Kan & Timmer,, 1987 ) , and is related to gradient-sampling approaches for nonsmooth optimization on manifolds ( Hosseini & Uschmajew,, 2017 ) ; differentiability almost everywhere does not supply the smoothness assumptions needed below.

blocks.en: The GEO scorer takes the first four competitor claims in the supplied list and appends the candidate at source position five. It does not retrieve pages from a deployed engine. Equation ( 9 ) credits all words in a sentence when it cites [5], even if it also cites another source. There is no division by the number of citations within that sentence and no subsequent normalization across source scores. These implementation details distinguish it from other position-adjusted impression measures; the reported values must be interpreted with this exact formula.
blocks.zh: GEO得分者在所提供的名单中取了前四个竞争者的权利要求,并在第五个来源位置附加候选人. 它不会从部署的引擎取回页面。 等式 (9) 引用 [5] 时,在句子中记出所有单词,即使它也引用了另一个来源. 该句内没有按引用次数划分,其后各源分数也没有正常化。 这些执行细节将其与其他位置调整后印象措施区分开来;报告数值必须用这一精确公式来解释。

blocks.en: For synthetic data, concept decoding uses an expanded pool of eight words, reranked by absolute VADER compound score to retain five. This reranking is shared by random, Demand-only, Defensibility-only, and GapScore variants. The generator receives the target label separately; the final polarity check uses the sign and the thresholds described in Section 3.6 . Data Accumulation does not use this same quality filter in this comparison. Equal final sample counts therefore control training-set size, but do not isolate direction choice from filtering or equalize generation cost.

blocks.en: Two earlier fidelity checks were tried first: GPT-4o-mini self-evaluation returned 100% fidelity for all six methods, and a seed-trained TF-IDF classifier produced unstable rankings with only ten examples per class. The adopted VADER check avoids fitting a fidelity classifier on that small seed. It is still a lexicon-based proxy and can misread contextual sentiment, especially irony or mixed polarity.

blocks.en: E.1 Separate Multi-Generator Runs
blocks.zh: E.1 单独的多发电机 运行

blocks.en: Each generator in this study supplies both the undirected and directed texts; the embedding, Qwen decoding, GPT plausibility screen, and VADER check remain fixed. These runs use K = 1 K=1 and five generations. Table 16 reports the supplementary differences from Data Accumulation across the four generators, including Gemini-2.0-Flash.
blocks.zh: 本研究中的每个生成器都提供未定向和定向文本;嵌入式,Quen解码式,GPT的可信屏幕和VADER检查仍然固定. 这些跑道使用K=一K=一和五代. 表16报告了包括双子座2.0-Flash在内的四台发电机数据积累的补充差异。

blocks.en: Table 16: Separate four-generator synthetic-data runs. Differences are GapScore minus Data Accumulation. Negative Collision and positive Vendi differences are favorable. No accuracy-by-model values were supplied.
blocks.zh: 表16:分离出四源合成数据运行. 差异是差距分数减去数据积累。 负碰撞和正 Vendi 差异是有利的。 未提供按模式排列的精确值。

blocks.en: The GPT-4o-mini values in Table 16 come from this separate four-generator run rather than the main-text budget-matched comparison ( − 0.026 -0.026 Collision, + 2.04 +2.04 Vendi), since the two experiments use different sampling procedures and should not be pooled. For Qwen, the reported accumulation Vendi is 29.78, making the deficit roughly 2.5%. Without repeated runs or intervals, it cannot be dismissed as noise or attributed to model size. The generator-level spread in this table is consistent with broader evidence that recursive synthetic-data training can degrade generative distributions ( Shumailov et al.,, 2023 ) and erode diversity within a model’s own outputs ( Guo et al.,, 2023 ) , though neither prior result was measured on this pipeline.
blocks.zh: 表16中的GPT-4-mini值来自这个单独的四源数据运行,而不是预算与主文本匹配的比较(-0.026-0.026碰撞,+2.04+2.04 Vendi),因为这两个实验采用不同的取样程序,不应集合. 对Quen来说,报告的积累是29.78起,赤字约为2.5%。 不重复运行或间隔,它不能作为噪音或被归因于模型大小而去掉. 本表中的生成层分布符合更广泛的证据,即递归合成数据培训可以降解基因分配(Shumailov等,2023年),并侵蚀模型本身产出的多样性(Guo等,2023年),尽管在这一管道上没有测量到先前的结果。

blocks.en: E.2 Direction-Set Diagnostics and Fidelity
blocks.zh: E.2 定向定点诊断和精准度

blocks.en: The K = 3 K=3 experiment studies the directions themselves. It is distinct from the K = 1 K=1 end-to-end comparison. The recorded SetGapScore values and available mean-direction diagnostic values are shown in Table 17 .
blocks.zh: K=3K=3实验研究方向本身. 与K=一K=一端对一端比较不同. 记录的SetGapScore值和可用的正向诊断值见表17。

blocks.en: Table 17: Synthetic-data direction-set diagnostics ( K = 3 K=3 ). A dash indicates a diagnostic not computed for that method. The two columns evaluate different aggregations, not repeated measurements of the same metric.
blocks.zh: 表17:合成-数据方向集诊断(K=3K=3). 破折号表示没有为这种方法计算诊断。 两栏评价的是不同的汇总,而不是同一度量的重复测量.

blocks.en: GapScore’s set score is approximately 44% higher than its mean-direction score, reflecting the different aggregation. This is not a 44% improvement in generated-data quality. Demand-only yields identical directions, so its coverage maximum and per-direction demand coincide. Defensibility-only also gives diagnostic values of Collision 0.259 and Vendi 32.10, showing that strong final-sample diversity can coexist with a negative direction score; these do not justify replacing downstream evaluation by SetGapScore.
blocks.zh: GapScore的设定分数大约比其平均方向分高了44%,反映了不同的汇总. 这在生成数据的质量方面并没有44%的改善。 只有需求才能产生相同的方向,因此其覆盖范围最大和每个方向的需求一致. 只有可防御性还给出了Collision 0.259和Vendi 32.10的诊断值,表明强烈的最终样本多样性可以与负方向分数并存;这些并不能证明用SetGapScore取代下游评价是合理的.

blocks.en: A qualitative comparison of K = 1 K=1 and K = 3 K=3 for Gemini-2.0-Flash shows that spreading the generation quota across three directions improved Vendi relative to accumulation but worsened Collision and accuracy, whereas the one-direction variant improved all three. A full K K -sensitivity curve is not reported here. Retained-sample matching targets eight examples per label per generation, with at most four retry rounds.
blocks.zh: 对双子座2.0-Flash的K = 1 K = 1和K = 3 K = 3进行质的比较表明,将生成配额分布在三个方向上,比起积累,提高了Vendi,但提高了碰撞和准确度,而一向变体则改善了所有三个方向。 这里没有报告完整的 K K 敏感曲线 。 保留-样本匹配每代标签8个实例,最多4个重试回合.

blocks.en: Appendix F Available Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: 附录F 可用的快速模板

blocks.en: The following templates are given as ordinary text, with braced names denoting runtime substitutions. The selection and filtering prompts are given verbatim; the final answer/synthetic-sample generation prompt is described qualitatively in § 3 rather than reproduced verbatim.
blocks.zh: 以下模板作为普通文本提供,并有缩放名称来表示运行时的替换. 选择和过滤提示是逐字给出的;最后的答案/合成-样本生成提示是在§3中进行定性描述,而不是逐字复制.

blocks.en: F.1 Qwen Concept Selection
blocks.zh: F.1 Quen概念选择

blocks.en: Query: ‘ {query} ’. Candidate words: {candidates} .
blocks.zh: 问曰:"(出"通鉴"). 候选词 : {候选人已}.

blocks.en: Select up to {top_n} words from the candidates that would make good ANSWERS to this query—concrete, creative, unexpected words. Do NOT select words that are synonyms of the key concepts in the query. Return only the selected words, comma-separated, best first.
blocks.zh: 从候选人中选择最多 {top_n} 的字句, 将给此查询提供好的 RESWERS —— 具体、 有创意、 出乎意料的字句 。 不要选择查询中关键概念的同义词。 只返回选定的单词, 逗号分隔, 最好先返回 。

blocks.en: The documented decode settings are temperature 0.0 and max_tokens=40 . The numerical direction is used to retrieve the candidates, not passed directly to the model.
blocks.zh: 所记录的解码设置为:温度0.0和最大值_tokens=40. 数字方向用于取回候选人,而不是直接传递给模型.

blocks.en: F.2 Answer Plausibility Filter
blocks.zh: F.2 回答可视性过滤器

blocks.en: Query: ‘ {query} ’. Words: {words} .
blocks.zh: 问曰:"(出"通鉴"). 口语:{口语}.

blocks.en: Which of these words could be answers to the query question? Think about what the query is asking for, then decide if synonyms of the query’s key concepts should be excluded as answers. Return only those words, comma-separated. Maximum {top_n} words.
blocks.zh: 其中哪一个词可以回答询问的问题? 考虑一下询问要求什么,然后决定是否应该排除查询关键概念的同义词作为答案. 只回那些词,逗号分隔。 最大 {top_n} 单词 。

blocks.en: F.3 GEO Plausibility Filter
blocks.zh: F.3. 全球环境展望 透明过滤器

blocks.en: Market: {market_desc} . Query: ‘ {market_query} ’. Words: {words} .
blocks.zh: 市场:{市场_desc}. 腾讯:"{市场_query}". 口语:{口语}.

blocks.en: Which of these words could be answers to the query question? Think about what the query is asking for, then decide if synonyms of the query’s key concepts should be excluded as answers. Return only those words, comma-separated. Maximum {top_n} words.
blocks.zh: 其中哪一个词可以回答询问的问题? 考虑一下询问要求什么,然后决定是否应该排除查询关键概念的同义词作为答案. 只回那些词,逗号分隔。 最大 {top_n} 单词 。

blocks.en: F.4 Citation Simulation
blocks.zh: F.4 引用模拟

blocks.en: Write an accurate and concise answer for the given user question, using ONLY the provided summarized web search results. Every sentence must be immediately followed by an in-line citation using the format [1][2][3].
blocks.zh: 为给定的用户问题写一个准确而简洁的答案,只使用所提供的简要网络搜索结果。 每句后必须立即使用格式 [1][2][3] 的行内引用.

blocks.en: Question: {market_query} .
blocks.zh: 问题:{market_query}.

blocks.en: Search Results: {source_text} .
blocks.zh: 搜索结果: {source_text}.

blocks.en: The source text enumerates four competitor claims followed by the candidate claim. The response is split into sentences, and sentences containing [5] contribute their position-weighted word counts to Eq. ( 9 ). The scorer uses zero-based sentence indices.
blocks.zh: 来源文本列举了四个竞争者索赔,然后是候选人索赔。 反应分为句子,包含 [5] 的句子会贡献其位置加权的单词计数给 Eq. (9.). 得分者使用零基句指数.

blocks.en: F.5 Task-Label Plausibility Filter
blocks.zh: F.5 任务标签可视性过滤器

blocks.en: Task: {task_desc} . Label space: {label_names} . Words: {words} .
blocks.zh: 任务 : {任务_desc}. 标签空间 : {label_names}. 口语:{口语}.

blocks.en: Which of these words correspond to a valid instance of this classification task? Exclude words that are off-topic or do not correspond to any class. Return only those words, comma-separated. Maximum {top_n} words.
blocks.zh: 这些词中哪一个对应了这个分类任务的有效实例? 不包括不切题或与任何类不符的词. 只回那些词,逗号分隔。 最大 {top_n} 单词 。

blocks.en: F.6 Text-Generation Instructions
blocks.zh: F.6 文本编制指示

blocks.en: For answering, the described prompt combines the query, three concept words, the forbidden-word list, and recurring sentence patterns, and requests one new sentence per direction. For GEO, it requests a product-claim sentence using the accepted concepts without duplicating competitor claims. For synthetic data, it requests labeled examples covering the accepted concepts, followed by the polarity check. These descriptions establish the conditioning variables but do not substitute for exact generation prompts, decoding settings, or raw completions.
blocks.zh: 对于回答,所描述的快取将查询,三个概念词,被禁词列表,和反复出现的句子模式相融合,请求每个方向再加一句. 就地球观测组织而言,它要求使用公认的概念,而不重复竞争者的索赔,作出产品索赔判决。 对于合成数据,它要求有包含被接受的概念的被标记的例子,然后是极性检查. 这些描述设定了条件变量,但不能取代精确生成提示,解码设置,或原始完成.
